description: This file defines the DateFieldRenderer class responsible for rendering date fields into RTF format within the MigraDoc document rendering library. It includes methods for translating date formats based on culture and formatting rules, and for generating the current date string.

classes.name: DateFieldRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders DateField objects into RTF format, translating date formats and generating date strings.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Renders the date field into RTF by writing the 'DATE' keyword, translating the format, and closing the field.

methods.name: GetEffectiveFormat
methods.description: Determines the effective date format string based on the DateField and culture info.

methods.name: TranslateFormat
methods.description: Converts the date format string into RTF-compatible format, handling culture-specific patterns and custom characters.

methods.name: TranslateCustomFormatChar
methods.description: Translates individual custom date format characters into RTF format.

methods.name: GetFieldResult
methods.description: Returns the current date as a string formatted according to the effective format.
